description: List the readable exhibits (individual documents with stored text) within an SEC filing, by internal filing ID. Returns each exhibit's `id`, exhibit type, description, content size and sec_url. Use the `id` with get_exhibit_content. Excludes XML/XBRL. For the COMPLETE document list of a filing by accession number (including files with no stored text), use get_filing_documents.

filingId.description: Internal filing ID (numeric). Find via search_sec_filings.

name: get_filing_exhibits
title: Get Filing Exhibits
